meta.name: doc-coauthoring
meta.description: Guide users through a structured workflow for co-authoring documentation. Use when user wants to write documentation, proposals, technical specs, decision docs, or similar structured content. This workflow helps users efficiently transfer context, refine content through iteration, and verify the doc works for readers. Trigger when user mentions writing docs, creating proposals, drafting specs, or similar documentation tasks.

copy.tagline: 按结构化流程协作撰写文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要与他人协作撰写结构化的文档或提案
copy.tagline_en: Collaborate on structured documentation with a guided workflow
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to co-author structured documents or proposals with others

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你通过三个步骤协作写文档：先收集背景信息，再逐段构思和修改，最后用全新的对话测试文档是否清晰易懂。
howto.when: 当你提到要写文档、提案、技术规格或类似内容时，Claude 会主动提供这个协作流程。

say.text: 帮我写一份关于新功能的技术规格书。
say.note: Claude 会启动三阶段协作流程。

say.text: 我想起草一个决策文档，讨论是否迁移数据库。
say.note: Claude 会先询问背景信息。

say.text: 我们一起来完善这份提案的引言部分。
say.note: Claude 会进入细化阶段，逐段优化。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you through a three-stage workflow for co-authoring documents: gather context, refine each section through brainstorming and editing, and test the doc with a fresh Claude to ensure clarity.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention writing documentation, proposals, technical specs, or similar tasks.

say_en.text: Help me write a technical spec for a new feature.
say_en.note: Claude will start the three-stage workflow.

say_en.text: I want to draft a decision doc about migrating the database.
say_en.note: Claude will first ask for background context.

say_en.text: Let's refine the introduction of this proposal together.
say_en.note: Claude will enter the refinement stage.
